{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm
filtered_penguins = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = filtered_penguins.groupby('species', as_index=False)['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Sort by mean flipper length in descending order
mean_flipper_by_species = mean_flipper_by_species.sort_values(by='flipper_length_mm', ascending=False)

# Print the full result to capture exact values
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Extract the species with the highest mean
highest_species = mean_flipper_by_species.iloc[0]['species']

# Print the result
print(f'\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_species}')"}
